title: Jelly-Like Syrian Tomato Tagine
description: A buttery, velvety, adventurous Syrian dish featuring tomato puree, perfect for a cold evening meal or a special occasion. This recipe is vegan-friendly and rich in flavors.

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use high-quality extra virgin olive oil for best results.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.notes: Chop the onion finely for a smooth tagine.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic for a subtle flavor.

ingredients.name: Tomato puree
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought, puree is the base of this recipe.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use kosher or sea salt for a better flavor.

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best results.

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chop the parsley finely and use as garnish.

ingredients.name: Vegan butter or oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality vegan butter or oil for a richer flavor.

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.notes: Use filtered water for a better flavor.

ingredients.name: Dried sumac
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a nice tanginess.

ingredients.name: Dried thyme
ingredients.notes: Optional, but adds a nice herbal flavor.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saut 5 it until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and saut 5 for another minute.
Add the tomato puree, spices, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine.
Add the chopped parsley, vegan butter or oil, and water. Stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 20-25 minutes, or until the tagine has thickened and reduced slightly.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley and sumac if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze the leftovers for up to 5 days.
